explication: DeepStream is an NVIDIA GStreamer-based streaming analytics SDK. The principal workflow is: an operator configures a pipeline, sources provide media, hardware-accelerated plugins decode and preprocess it, TensorRT performs inference, tracking and metadata stages enrich results, and display, encoding, or message-broker outputs deliver analytics. Service Maker and PipelineContext provide orchestration and lifecycle control. The repository also includes an evaluation/fine-tuning web application. Several plugin internals are represented at directory level because only selected headers and implementations were sampled.
